title: Miguel made this our favorite excursion!!
text: We would give 10 stars if possible!! Great communication with tour company and our guide, Miguel. He arrived on time and took us to several beautiful places!! Catered the tour to our request and made this our most memorable day!! We can not say enough good things about Miguel!! Highly, highly recommend!! Thank you, thank you, thank you, Miguel!!
author: June_R

title: Accommodating and flexible.
text: Miguel was excellent driver/guide. Enjoyable experience. On time prompt efficient. Informative. Loved extra stop, overall great time.
author: Steven_S

title: A wonderful and unexpected day trip to beat the heat of Sevilla
text:
First off, Luis was the best and most amenable and helpful tour guide. Our teenagers wanted to jet ski and Luis assisted us in making this happen and then brought us to a nearby beach where we relaxed, swam and enjoyed a delicious local lunch that our whole family enjoyed. 
Luis was flexible and also helpful with suggestions. He brought us first to the quaint and quite special town El Rocio, which was a hidden gem that I recommend others to see who book this trip.

author: Jim_C

title: Amazing day out on beautiful beach!!!
text: We had a wonderful day out on the beach. Our driver Luis was extremely nice and helpful, giving us a few options and then tailoring the trip to our needs. He provided us with everything we needed for the beach including towels and beach toys and was flexible with time which enabled us to spend as much time as we wanted to there. On the way, we also visited a lovely small pilgrimage village with a famous church. author: Agnieszka_M

title: Fun in the sun ☀️
text: Our trip to Maneli beach was fantastic! Our diver left it up to us to either go to a more secluded less crowded beach or go to a more tourist area with bars and restaurants. We chose the more secluded area and had a blast on the beach. It was exactly what we wanted. Our driver was very friendly and the van was comfortable.
author: Diana_G
